verdict.rationale: Vanta ships a Trust Center that automates security reviews and gives prospects purchase-decision information (vanta-docs-19). The platform continuously monitors controls and collects evidence (vanta-docs-45, vanta-docs-49), and its TPRM agent auto-discovers vendors (vanta-docs-13). However, no evidence says the Trust Center automatically pulls control status, subprocessor lists, or document renewals from the platform, so that link is only implied. Missing for 10: documented auto-sync of control status to the Trust Center, automatic subprocessor list publishing, automated document renewal or expiry updates, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
